title: Automatic hyperelliptic BSD pipeline
objective: Atomically assemble a fully certified-or-supplied genus-2/3 BSD analytic quotient with independent per-factor provenance and structured incomplete-factor outcomes

oracles: Pinned PARI BSD oracle corpus and exact BSD quotient contracts
Independent factor certificate replay and precision refinement

handoff.summary: Added the standalone compute_bsd_analytic_quotient pipeline, immutable/replayable complete and incomplete reports, exact factor contracts with independent provenance, SQLite checkpoint rows, quotient-method proxies, typed subgroup-index forwarding, a complete supplied-Neron rank-zero fixture, and explicit incomplete positive-rank coverage.
risks: Automatic genus-3 positive-rank regulators remain an explicit unsupported capability unless a provenanced regulator or pairing is supplied.

pnpm architecture:check reaches package-graph validation but the integrated hyperelliptic-curves-algorithms package is already over its lazy source budget; package registration/splitting is owned by the integration lane.
next_steps: Integration should register the lazy module and add the central curve method without importing it eagerly.
Merge the saturation lane's replayable SubgroupIndexData adapter; the pipeline already accepts subgroup_index and the report proxies with_subgroup_index.
